name: Istinye University

programs.title: You must have finished secondary school and earned a high school diploma or its equivalent. The Turkish Ministry of Education or an equivalent institution should acknowledge the certification.
To apply to Istinye University, you must complete the application form and send the required documentation.
You must have earned your applicable bachelor's degree from an accredited institution or its equivalent. Depending on the curriculum, a specific academic background may be optional.
You must submit transcripts from your undergraduate studies. These transcripts should demonstrate your academic performance as well as the courses you've taken.
You must have a Turkish Proficiency Certificate (C1).
A bachelor's degree or international equivalent (at least Lower Second Class) or comparable professional certification is required.
Proof of English language proficiency at or above the IELTS 6.5 level or any other equivalent (where applicable).

description: The Anatolian Foundation of the 21st Century established Istinye University in 2015 as a continuation of the MLP Care Group's 25 years of experience and skill, integrating under one roof three distinct hospital brands: "Liv Hospital," "Medical Park," and "VM Medical Park.". Istinye University strives to rank among the most prestigious universities in Turkey by producing new knowledge through its educational and research performance and by assisting its students in becoming knowledgeable in their fields by disseminating existing knowledge. Istinye University's academic staff is successfully committed to education and research to make a difference. In keeping with its mission to be a science and research hub, Istinye University strives to apply a student-centered understanding of education to its operations. Through the research of its academic staff, the University hopes to advance the boundaries of science, put scientific discoveries into practice for social welfare, and provide the community with high-quality, easily accessible healthcare services. By implementing educational, research, and social service programs at international standards, Istinye University offers its students a wide range of abilities and a learning and inclusive environment that spans technology and art.
